name: Interfaith Relationships
overview: Scripture clearly warns against forming covenants and marriages with those who do not share faith in the Lord, as such unions are described as snares and trespasses against God (Exodus 34:12; Ezra 10:2). The Old Testament commands believers not to intermarry with the nations they are called to inherit, emphasizing separation to maintain covenant faithfulness (Deuteronomy 7:3; Nehemiah 13:25). This principle is underscored by the rhetorical question in Amos 3:3, highlighting that unity and agreement are essential for walking together, which is foundational for relationships grounded in shared faith.
